coverage_notes: EXHAUSTIVE market research sweep across diagramming/visualization tools (Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, Figma/FigJam, Mermaid) and adjacent AI agent/RAG/low-code spaces. Covered 5 primary angles: (1) UX/design teardowns via official comparisons and credible analysis (T0-T2); (2) market sizing & CAGR via analyst reports (research and markets, verified market research, OMR Global) showing diagramming market ~$1-2.5B in 2025 growing 9-12.8% CAGR, visual collaboration at $6.67-17.58B with 10-22.9% CAGR; (3) analyst positioning via Gartner Magic Quadrant on low-code platforms; (4) company funding & valuation via official announcements and company databases (Miro $17.5B Series C 2022, Figma $68B post-IPO 2025, Lucidchart $3B 2021, draw.io bootstrapped, Mermaid Chart $7.5M seed 2024); (5) product documentation and user reviews via G2/Capterra/Miro reviews; (6) adjacent competitive intel via agentic RAG/workflow builder landscape (Dify, RAGFlow, Vellum architectures) and low-code platform market ($34.7B 2024, 11.6% CAGR); (7) HCI/usability research from ACM CHI and academic sources. Dedup strategy: Merged duplicate market sizing (kept highest-authority analyst reports); consolidated tool comparisons (official + credible third-party); eliminated low-value listicles. Ranked by: T0 official sources → T1 analyst/review aggregators → T2 practitioner/seminal guides → T3 secondary coverage. Notable: comprehensive T0-T1 on all 5 core tools; market data cross-validated across 2-3 sources per category; HCI research grounded in academic literature. Gaps: Specific Forrester Wave on diagram software (paywall); detailed user research on long-form workflows; support forum pain points (auth required).
